description:
Who We Are

At IPID, we're building trust in global payments. Our account verification solutions help financial institutions, payment service providers, and enterprises verify account ownership before payments are sent, reducing fraud, improving compliance, and helping money reach the right recipient with confidence.

Founded by industry veterans from organisations including SWIFT and Thomson Reuters, IPID combines deep payments expertise with modern technology to help make global payments safer, simpler, and more reliable. As we continue to grow, we're looking for talented people who enjoy solving meaningful problems and want to make a visible impact in a fast-moving global fintech.

The Opportunity

Our customers—including global banks and payment providers—rely on IPID whenever they send a payment. As our customer base and global network grow, we’re looking for a senior, hands-on practitioner to lead post-go-live technical support and service operations.

You’ll take ownership of customer support delivery, escalations and high-severity incidents while helping us build a scalable support function. You’ll work cases and lead incidents directly, improve our processes, knowledge and tooling, and set the operational standard as the team grows.

Working closely with Technology, Product, Implementation and Customer Success, you’ll have significant influence over how we support customers worldwide.

What You'll Be Doing 

Customer support

  • Own the end-to-end support process: intake, triage, investigation, resolution and customer communication.
  • Lead high-severity incidents and customer escalations, with clear ownership, timely updates and effective resolution.
  • Run service requests, technical investigations and root-cause analysis, turning lessons learned into lasting improvements.
  • Coordinate internal and external stakeholders during cases and incidents, and manage maintenance and outage communications to customers.
  • Build the support knowledge base and strengthen L1 and L2 capability across the team.

Service operations

  • Monitor service quality and health against agreed service levels, and act on emerging issues.
  • Act as incident commander, coordinating remediation across technical teams.
  • Escalate operational issues to data providers in our global network and follow them through to resolution.
  • Carry out approved failover and switch-over procedures, and help define and test business-continuity capabilities.
  • Improve workflow automation and data quality across support processes and tools.
  • Apply working knowledge of networking, cryptography and information security principles when investigating incidents and assessing service risk.

Scaling support

  • Lead a cross-functional virtual support team across Technology and other functions.
  • Refine support-readiness criteria so every customer has clear escalation paths and a named support owner before go-live.
  • Track support and service performance, identify recurring issues and drive improvements with Product and Technology.
  • Help shape IPID's next generation of support, including AI-assisted capabilities, and establish practices that scale to a growing, globally distributed customer base.
  • Experience: 8+ years in technical support, production support or service operations, including senior L2/L3 work on mission-critical production services.
  • Incident leadership: Proven experience personally managing high-severity incidents and customer escalations, coordinating technical responders and communicating clearly with customers under pressure.
  • Business-critical environments: Experience supporting services where availability, reliability and response times are critical, ideally in payments, banking, fintech, financial infrastructure or another regulated, high-availability environment.
  • Service management: Strong practical knowledge of incident, problem and change management (ITIL-style), SLA governance and root-cause analysis.
  • ICT foundation: Broad foundational knowledge of information and communications technology (ICT), including computer networking, cryptography and information security principles, acquired through specialised study in a relevant field or proven practical experience.
  • Hands-on investigation: Ability to investigate technical issues using logs, monitoring and observability tools, and API request/response data. Comfortable being the senior hands-on practitioner, not only managing a team.
  • Tooling: Experience with ticketing and observability platforms such as Jira Service Management, ServiceNow, Datadog, Splunk, Elastic or Grafana, or similar.
  • Vendor and partner oversight: Experience managing an outsourced support provider against SLAs, or equivalent vendor and partner management.
  • Continuous improvement: Demonstrated ability to turn recurring support issues into runbooks, monitoring, automation, knowledge or product improvements.
  • Communication and mindset: Excellent written and spoken English, with the judgement to explain technical incidents to customers and senior non-technical stakeholders. Calm, structured and decisive, with strong ownership, and comfortable in an international, fast-changing start-up where the support model is still being established.
  • Right to work: Legal authorisation to work in the country where the role is based.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with payments infrastructure, account validation, verification of payee or financial networks.
  • Exposure to business continuity (BCP), disaster recovery (DR) or failover planning.
  • Experience with Azure, AWS or Google Cloud Platform.
  • Experience with vulnerability management in a live service environment, including coordinating remediation with Technology.
  • Experience working in a globally distributed start-up or high-growth company.
  • ITIL 4 Foundation certification or strong practical IT service-management experience.

What We Offer

  • Meaningful Impact – Help build trust in global payments by solving real-world challenges for financial institutions, fintechs, and businesses worldwide.
  • Learn from Industry Experts – Gain exposure to global customers, payment ecosystems, and experienced professionals across fintech, payments, and technology.
  • Ownership & Growth – Thrive in a collaborative environment where your contributions are visible, valued, and supported through opportunities for learning and career development.

Working in accordance with applicable laws, IPID prohibits discrimination against any applicant or employee based on any legally-recognized basis, including, but not limited to: race, colour, religion, sex (including pregnancy, lactation, childbirth or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, age, national origin or ancestry, citizenship status, physical or mental disability, genetic information (including testing and characteristics), veteran status, uniformed service member status or any other status protected by national or local laws of the jurisdiction in which the applicant resides.

If you need assistance or request accommodation during the recruitment process, please contact

Please note that only shortlisted candidates will be notified. All information gathered will be treated in strict confidence and solely used for recruitment purposes.

To protect the interests of all parties, IPID does not accept unsolicited resumes from a third party agency or search firm recruiters. Any unsolicited resumes sent to any IPID employee, regardless of the means of transmission, will become the sole property of IPID. We will not pay a fee for any placement resulting from the receipt of an unsolicited resume.
